aim: Can initially separate inherited assurance-accessibility and investment standing variance reveal when a predicted access-delay plus selection-response clock generalizes across new finite histories?

prior_exposed_evidence.history_cutoff: Existing 2,304-case old outcomes and 6,144 genetic-width histories were already exposed. Pilot is NOT independent historical validation.

biological_source: Require exact authenticated Model3 original 2026-10-11 source package; no modifications to reproduction, inheritance, recruitment or mutation kernel. A new orchestration wrapper must be reviewed separately.

factorial.I_scale_definition: I_new = original pooled founding I allele mean + c*(I_original - original pooled founding I allele mean)
factorial.independence_condition: Full 2x2 crossing within each original founder; A-width does not change I source alleles; I-scaling does not change A or M source alleles.
factorial.I_initial_allele_mean: unaltered per founder; original main=.5078125, confirmation=.515625
factorial.A_F1_segregation_potential: w²/2 under no mutation and independent meiosis; not observed next-generation variance
factorial.no_mutation_A_accessibility_at_delta0.05: w<.05 structurally inaccessible; w>.05 allele support permits but never guarantees event
factorial.names_are_abstract: A and I are synthetic Model3 axes; not observed autonomous selfing rates or literal flower size.

pilot.purpose: prospective FEASIBILITY and precision estimation only, not successful Q1-Q2 clock confirmation
pilot.independent_stream_definition: (founder_block, replicate) cryptographic salted seed; same source stream used for its three environments and four factorial arms
pilot.technical_fixture_streams: distinct salt; excluded from 1,536; no source-substitution
pilot.retain: all annual genotypes (all loci and homologs), ancestry/parents, census, mutation flags, reproduction F/P/S ledgers, visitor context, event and comparison receipts
pilot.strict_censoring: event not sustained by update 200 = unobserved; extinct genotype mean undefined, never zero; keep six outcome categories
pilot.pilot_allowed_usage: judge producer correctness, observed process feasibility and groupwise score-difference variance; selecting coefficient/model using pilot may inform an entirely NEW independent confirmation design but is NOT itself evidence
pilot.pilot_forbidden_usage: no cohort re-use in confirm, no retuning parameters/thresholds/horizon after outcomes, no retrospective reclassification of original failed/nonsupported tests

confirmation.goal: independent-history heldout six-class log-score difference of mechanistic access+response clock versus equal-or-greater-flexibility ecology/genetic-interaction null
confirmation.primary_metric: six-class log loss averaged over all starts (not only strict two-event histories)
confirmation.evaluation_units: founder-block stratified paired visitor-history clusters; all 12 cells within cluster remain joined
confirmation.planned_power: Assumption envelope only; choose n from pilot sigma (floor .15, 512 <= n <= 1024, 128-cluster rounding); no main execution until pilot and predictive algorithm are reviewed
confirmation.model_algorithms: NOT FROZEN: mechanistic τ_A access+response and τ_I from full parent returns require pre-execution published mathematical definition, software and test fixtures
confirmation.larger_null: equal or more flexible ecological supply/composition × genetic variance/supply interaction, with same training and calibration opportunity as clock
confirmation.no_intervention_on_nat_order: This design tests forecast and response processes; no claim of natural-order-mediated Q4 benefit.

execute_rules: Do not dispatch any biological trajectories on this PR or during the feasibility audit.
Review and authenticate exact original biology, 2x2 founder transformation, 12-cell coupled-stream mapping and source/runtime hashes before pilot.
Execute only a single 1,536-case pilot after immutable pilot design and original source manifest are approved; no adaptive case adds.
Reader-only independent verification, complete participant IDs, origin/mutation ancestry and all six endpoint categories precede any biological conclusion.
Power and fully specified predictor/null contract must be separately frozen before new confirmation histories, never using their outcomes.
If pilot sd implies >1024 confirm history clusters under fixed .02 threshold, stop and report NO-GO (do not relax target).
No merge/promotion to one-paper main claim from pilot-only results.
